content.text: In Kenya, digital creators face a critical barrier: global [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-only-real|payment]] platforms like Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or severely restricted. This isn’t just an inconvenience—it’s a blockade on your ability to sell ebooks, courses, templates, or software globally. The solution isn’t a workaround; it’s sovereign commerce infrastructure. This post unpacks the real [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-behind-digital-product-stores-kyc-payments|The Real]] behind Solana payments for digital products, built to bypass financial isolation. No platforms. No subscriptions. Full ownership. If you’ve been locked out of conventional systems, this is how you reclaim control.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

This architecture is a self-hosted commerce stack designed to process Solana payments for digital products without relying on third-party platforms. It combines GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. The core value? Infrastructure sovereignty. You own the entire stack. No platform can shut you down, no subscription can expire, and no geographic restriction applies. This isn’t a temporary fix—it’s a permanent solution built to withstand payment rejections, currency collapses, and financial isolation. For creators in Kenya, this means selling globally without intermediaries. The stack is deployed in 48 hours, and once live, it operates autonomously. Payments are verified on-chain, products are delivered instantly, and data remains yours. This is commerce infrastructure as it should be: yours, not rented.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s the step-by-step flow: A buyer selects your digital product and pays in Solana via NOWPayments. The transaction is verified on-chain within seconds, triggering a webhook that fires into Cloudflare Workers. This backend logic checks payment status, logs the order in Supabase, and generates a secure, time-limited download link. The link is sent to the buyer’s email (configured via SPF/DKIM/DMARC for deliverability), and the product is delivered from Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. Every component is decoupled—no single point of failure. Solana’s low transaction fees (under $0.10) and fast confirmation times make it ideal for microtransactions. The stack is stateless: no server management, no database bloat. It scales automatically with demand. This isn’t a hacked-together script—it’s enterprise-grade infrastructure, pressure-tested in environments like Zimbabwe, where financial systems fail daily.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are inaccessible or unreliable. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software, and you’ve been locked out of Stripe or PayPal, this is your solution. It’s also for creators who refuse to rent their commerce infrastructure. With this stack, you own the hosting, the backend logic, the order storage, and the delivery mechanism. No platform can change its terms, no algorithm can throttle your reach, and no subscription can expire. This is for those who value sovereignty over convenience. It’s not the easiest path—but it’s the only path that guarantees control. If you’re tired of being rejected by payment platforms, this is how you build your own system.
Solana’s low fees and fast confirmations make it ideal for microtransactions.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages hosts your storefront—free, static, and globally distributed. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, from payment verification to email delivery, without servers. Supabase stores order data in a structured, queryable format, while Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive delivers files securely. NOWPayments acts as the payment gateway, verifying Solana transactions on-chain with a 0.5% fee and no KYC. Each component is open-source or free-tier, ensuring no hidden costs. The stack is modular: swap out Supabase for Google Sheets, or Cloudflare Workers for Google Apps Script, depending on your needs. The key is interoperability—every piece works together seamlessly. This isn’t a monolithic platform; it’s a combination of best-in-class tools, configured to serve your specific use case. The result? A commerce stack that’s as flexible as it is resilient.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start with the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. It includes all six blueprints, seven templates, and instant download access. Deploy Stack 02 (Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments) for a fully operational store in 48 hours. Load your products, configure your Solana wallet, and test end-to-end. Once live, the stack runs itself—no maintenance required. Need support? The kit includes 30 days of direct assistance. This isn’t a course or a tutorial; it’s a deployment package. You’re not learning to build—you’re deploying a proven architecture. If you’re ready to stop renting and start owning, this is your next step. Sovereign commerce isn’t a theory—it’s a stack. Deploy it today.

Solana payments for digital products work by integrating NOWPayments for on-chain transaction verification, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and Supabase for order storage. The buyer pays in Solana, the payment is verified instantly, and the product is delivered automatically via a secure link. This architecture is self-hosted, ensuring full ownership and no reliance on third-party platforms. It’s designed for creators in regions where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, providing a sovereign commerce solution.
Own your commerce infrastructure—no platforms, no subscriptions, no restrictions.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes pre-configured templates and 30-day support for deployment. You don’t need to write code—just follow the steps.
What if Solana transaction fees increase?
The stack supports multiple networks. Switch to BSC or TRON for fees under $0.10 per transaction. The architecture is network-agnostic.
Do I need to manage servers?
No. The stack is serverless, using Cloudflare Workers and GitHub Pages. No server management required.
Can I sell physical products with this stack?
No. This architecture is designed for automated delivery of digital products only.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
The stack is modular. Replace NOWPayments with any other crypto payment gateway that offers webhooks and on-chain verification.
